summary: Cloudflare Integration in Domain Manager - All backend tests passed (19/19). Frontend UI verified working with config dialog, connection status card, and proper visibility control for Sync/DNS panels based on config state.
critical_code_review_comments: domains.py: _get_cf_credentials() correctly returns 400 with Dutch error message when CF not configured
domains.py: Token is properly masked in GET /cloudflare/config response (shows last 8 chars only)
domains.py: All CF endpoints require system_admin role via require_system_admin dependency
domains.py: Cloudflare API calls use httpx with 30s timeout and proper error handling
DomainManager.js: Sync button and DNS Records panel correctly hidden when cfConfig?.configured is false
DomainManager.js: Config dialog has proper data-testid attributes for all inputs
DomainManager.js: API Token input uses password type with show/hide toggle
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudflare integration fully tested. Backend tests verify: (1) GET/PUT /api/domains/cloudflare/config work correctly, (2) verify-token, sync, dns-records return 400 when not configured, (3) Token is masked in responses. Frontend UI shows: Cloudflare tab with connection status card, Configure button opens dialog with API Token/Zone ID/Base Domain fields, Sync button and DNS Records panel only visible when configured.
